EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our “The future of expatriate insurance: ﻿Collaboration, innovation, and customer-first solutions” webinar!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We missed you! Our “The future of expatriate insurance: Collaboration, innovation, and customer-first solutions” webinar highlighted how insurers, tech providers, brokers, and payment partners can better collaborate to deliver flexible, seamless, and secure IPMI solutions for expatriates.
Our panelists featured:
- Manny Socorro, Strategic Director, Insurance at Flywire - Elliott Draga, Chief Commercial Officer at Nordic Insurance Software - Steve Martin, Head of Broker Sales, UK and Europe at Cigna - Brendan Cerff, Head of IT at William Russell
Here are links to the webinar recording <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/webinar-recording-the-future-of-expatriate-insurance-collaboration-innovation-and-customer-first-solutions]]>.
Have questions? You can reply to this email or contact Manny Socorro at manny.socorro@flywire.com <[[manny.socorro@flywire.com]]>.
Have a great day! Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
